description: This Python module implements an enterprise-specific custom SSO handler for the LiteLLM Proxy, providing methods to process incoming request headers for user authentication via OAuth proxies and returning appropriate redirect responses.

classes.name: EnterpriseCustomSSOHandler
classes.description: Provides methods for handling custom SSO authentication flows, allowing users to implement their own logic for processing request headers and returning user info in OpenID format.

methods.name: handle_custom_ui_sso_sign_in
methods.description: Asynchronously processes a FastAPI request to perform custom SSO sign-in, returning a redirect response to the user after handling authentication via custom headers.
